title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + metrics integration for prompt-set regression gating
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds per-prompt CI hooks and metrics integration for prompt-set regression gating. Improves signal fidelity for quality gating and reduces false positives in CI by annotating flakiness and per-prompt baselines.
description: Motivation: several recent regressions slipped through broad eval checks because signal was averaged across prompt sets. This PR adds per-prompt CI hooks and integrates per-prompt metrics into the existing eval-harness pipeline so regressions in narrow but important prompts are visible and can fail CI independently of aggregate metrics. Changes: 1) CI hook layer that runs per-prompt evaluation when a prompt-set or model change is detected. 2) Metrics integration that emits per-prompt precision/recall/qa scores to the metrics backend and tags them with prompt_id, model_version and run_id. 3) Quality gating rules config and a CLI helper to produce human-friendly diffs for failed prompts. 4) Flakiness annotations and retry heuristics for identified flaky prompts to reduce noisy CI failures. Testing: added unit tests for hook routing and metrics serializer, integration test that runs a sample prompt-set and validates emitted metrics, e2e smoke harness in CI. Backwards compatibility: hooks are opt-in via eval-harness config; default behavior unchanged. Related: ENG-2345, PM-112. Checklist: - [x] implement CI hook dispatcher - [x] add metrics serializer + emitter - [x] expose gating config and CLI diff tool - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and changelog entry - [x] verified on staging CI with model A and B Usage notes: to enable per-prompt gating add "per_prompt_gating: true" to eval-harness.yaml and configure thresholds. See docs link: https://redwood.internal/docs/eval-harness/per-prompt-ci-hooks (internal).
commits: feat(eval-harness): add per-prompt CI hook dispatcher
feat(metrics): per-prompt metrics serializer and emitter
chore(test): add integration test for per-prompt metrics emission
docs(eval-harness): document per-prompt gating config and CLI usage
fix(ci): handle flaky prompt retries and annotate runs
review_comments: Chris Nguyen: Left a couple of inline comments about retry backoff and visibility into retried runs. Can we ensure retries are surfaced in the CI summary?
Aisha Patel: Reply: updated summary output to include retry_count and retry_reason. PTAL
María López: Question: how do we avoid accidental spam to metrics backend when a PR triggers many runs? Suggest batching emit and sampling for noisy prompts.
Aisha Patel: Reply: implemented batching with a default 1s flush and a sampling opt-out for specific prompt tags. Added config and tests.
Omar Khan: Approving after small nits were fixed. Verified staging runs for model-A and model-B and saw per-prompt failures for flaky_prompt_42 which matched the incident notes.
CI Bot: e2e tests failed on first run due to transient model download timeout. Reran and all checks passed.
notes: Staging verification performed against models model-A@v2024-11-12 and model-B@v2024-11-10. Ops ran a short canary in production for 1 hour with no elevated error rate.
